# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates and fixes will be considered for the latest version of Brain Booster Academy.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability, please do not disclose sensitive technical details in a public GitHub issue.

Instead, report it privately through GitHub's repository security reporting feature, if available.

If private reporting is unavailable, contact the project maintainer through an appropriate private communication channel.

## What to Include

Please provide:

- A clear description of the potential vulnerability.
- Steps to reproduce the issue, where safe.
- The affected file or feature.
- Any relevant screenshots or supporting information.

## Response

The maintainer will review reported security concerns and determine appropriate next steps.

We appreciate responsible security research and efforts to keep educational software safe.
